name: Abdul Malek Ukil
contribution: Abdul Malek Ukil was a student leader and lawyer associated with the early Bengali language-rights movement.
context: He helped sustain student mobilisation through processions and picketing as the demand for recognition of Bengali developed after Pakistan’s creation.
impact: His generation carried the language question from campus activism into the broader constitutional and political struggle.
